regional_travel_notes: Kolkata street food trails focus on historic north and central culinary clusters.
Evening stalls at Dacre Lane open around 16:00.

candidate_places.name: Mitra Cafe Heritage Cabin
candidate_places.description: Century old north Kolkata dining institution famous for mutton diamond fry and brain cutlets.

candidate_places.name: Dacre Lane Food Street
candidate_places.description: Historic office district alley lined with artisanal stew, chowmein, and toast stalls.

candidate_places.name: Flurys Tea Room
candidate_places.description: Iconic Park Street European tearoom established in 1927 celebrated for English breakfast and rum balls.
